name: NPGX
summary: BBS/filebase/email/telnet/ftp/web + online gaming provider (Liverpool POP); defunct (NPGX PTY. LTD., ACN 072 229 031).

events.details: Last Wayback capture of own domain (c. 1997). Both c.1997 (current) and c.2000-02 (proposal) are wrong: NPGX ran actively through 2008 and its homepage became a GitGo Hosting redirect by Jun 2009. redirected to gitgohosting.com.

refs.label: NPGX was actively operating in 2004-05 — the 'frozen since Jun 2000' welcome.htm was just a legacy page
By 12 Jun 2009 the domain redirected to GitGo Hosting; by 2015 to ostech.com.au; control-panel placeholder by 2019
